description: List drafts in an inbox, most recently updated first, paginated. Each comes with its recipients, subject, preview, labels, and scheduled send time and status; filter by labels (e.g. "scheduled") to find scheduled drafts.

after.description: Only items at or after this time, as ISO 8601 with a timezone (e.g. 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z)

ascending.description: Sort by oldest first instead of most recent first

before.description: Only items before this time, as ISO 8601 with a timezone (e.g. 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z)

inboxId.description: Inbox ID: the inbox's email address, from list_inboxes

labels.description: Only items carrying all of these labels, such as unread or your own

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous page's result; omit for the first page
